item.title: Jeff Probst says casting 'Survivor 50' was "heartbreaking," reveals what he'd do differently
item.description: Survivor: Jeff Probst says casting 'Survivor 50' was "heartbreaking," reveals what he'd do differently. Survivor host Jeff Probst has admitted the casting process for Season 50 was "heartbreaking" and more difficult than fans may believe.

item.description: 90 Day Fiance: '90 Day Fiance': Rick confesses to cheating, Lisa sees "red flag," Birkan shocks Laura, Emma and Ziad sleep together. 90 Day Fiance: Before the 90 Days featured Rick confessing he cheated on Trisha, Lisa seeing "a crack" in her relationship with Daniel, Laura discovering Birkan's disturbing gambling habit, and Emma and Ziad finally consummating their relationship during the Season 8 episode that aired Sunday night on TLC.
